paragraphsHtml: Wynwood is part of Miami, where we're headquartered, so our own crew comes to your restaurant for every shoot. One shoot typically produces 4 to 6 weeks of content. We post it and manage your pages, and the same team can handle your Google Business Profile, your website and your ads.

Our nearest case study is Shimuja Ramen at Julia & Henry's, 200 E Flagler St in Downtown Miami. We've worked with Chef Kei for about four years, by his count, making short videos where the ramen is the star.

proof.bodyHtml: Shimuja Ramen has moved more than once, from Southwest Ranches to pop-ups and now to Julia & Henry's food hall. In Chef Kei's words, a lot of the customers who come try his ramen come directly from the social media marketing we've done for him.

steps.h2: How we'd get started in Wynwood

items.title: Book a free strategy call
items.bodyHtml: You'll spend 30 minutes with Juan, our co-founder. He looks over your Google Business Profile, website and social pages and tells you what he would change first.

items.title: Film a shoot day
items.bodyHtml: Our crew films at your restaurant on a day you pick, and we turn what we film into Reels, TikToks and photos.

items.title: Keep it running each month
items.bodyHtml: We post and manage your pages, keep your Google profile up to date through our restaurant SEO and AEO service, and send a monthly report. If you need a new site, we do restaurant website design too.

pricingHtml: Most restaurants invest $1,500 to $5,000 a month for a coordinated program. Website builds are a one-time $1,500 or $2,000.

faqs.q: Do you work with restaurants in Wynwood?
faqs.a: Yes. We're headquartered in Miami, and our crew works with Wynwood restaurants in person. Our nearest case study is Shimuja Ramen in Downtown Miami.

faqs.q: Will your team come to my restaurant to film?
faqs.a: Yes. Our own crew films at your restaurant, and we set the date and time with you. One shoot typically produces 4 to 6 weeks of content.

faqs.q: We have another location outside South Florida. Can you cover it?
faqs.a: Yes. Websites, SEO and AEO, and ads are done remotely, so we can handle them anywhere in the US. For social media, our Miami team plans and manages the content, and someone from our network of videographers and photographers in that area does the shoot.

faqs.q: Do you require a long-term contract?
faqs.a: No. We don't require long-term contracts. You can start with one service and add more later.

cta.h2: Let's talk about your Wynwood restaurant
cta.body: Book a free 30-minute call, and Juan, our co-founder, will tell you what he would do first for your restaurant. We can talk in English or Spanish.
